description: This file implements SHA1 hashing functions for the Data Encryption Unit (DEU) driver on Infineon Technologies hardware, including hardware-accelerated transform, initialization, update, and finalization routines, and registration of the SHA1 algorithm within the Linux crypto API.

methods.name: sha1_transform
methods.description: Main interface to SHA1 hardware for processing 64-byte input blocks.

methods.name: sha1_update
methods.description: Performs on-the-fly SHA1 computation with input data.

methods.name: sha1_final
methods.description: Computes the final SHA1 hash value.

methods.name: ifxdeu_init_sha1
methods.description: Registers the SHA1 driver with the Linux crypto API.

methods.name: ifxdeu_fini_sha1
methods.description: Unregisters the SHA1 driver from the Linux crypto API.
